class View:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows=[]
        self.notes={}
        self.loading=False
        self.error=None
        self.seq=0
        self.last_accepted_id=None
    
    def begin(self, query):
        self.seq += 1
        request_id = self.seq
        # Clear loading errors but keep existing rows until valid finish
        self.error = None
        return request_id
    
    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        # Check if this is the latest begun request
        if request_id != self.last_accepted_id:
            return False
        
        # Copy accepted rows (not just assign)
        new_rows = list(rows)
        self.rows = new_rows
        self.last_accepted_id = request_id
        # Set loading state based on successful completion
        self.loading = True
        return True
